Thanks! I spent a lot of time on the low-end. Did you check it on headphones?
Yes! The kick at 1:24 is punchy and well-defined. The bass sits perfectly in the mix.
Here's the QC report for reference:
Looking at the QC now. Loudness is -14.2 LUFS — perfect for streaming! True Peak at -1.2 dBTP is also solid.
@audioguy mentioned the dynamic range might be a bit low at 8.1 LU. What do you think?
I think 8.1 LU is fine for this genre. Lo-fi typically has less dynamic range. But we could try backing off the limiter 1 dB on the bridge section if you want to be safe.
Good idea. Let me try that and upload v3.3 👍
